instruction.text: Read the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Dalip loves peanuts. He eats all the peanuts he can find and always asks his mum for more. His mother keeps the peanuts in the kitchen in a jar with a small opening, about the size of a young boy’s fist.
atoms.sound: ssml: Dahleep loves peanuts. He eats all the peanuts he can find and always asks his mum for more. His mother keeps the peanuts in the kitchen in a jar with a small opening, about the size of a young boy’s fist.

atoms.text: “Mum! Can I have some peanuts?” he asks. “You may, but only the one handful, please. I don’t want you to spoil your dinner,” she replies. She hands an excited Dalip the jar. He reaches his small hand in and grabs as many peanuts as he can fit into his fist and then tries to pull his hand from the jar.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m3_2025'>“Mum! Can I have some peanuts?”</voice> he asks.<break time='600ms'/> <voice voice='f1'>“You may, but only the one handful please. I don’t want you to spoil your dinner,”</voice> she replies.<break time='600ms'/> She hands an excited Dahleep the jar. He reaches his small hand in and grabs as many peanuts as he can fit into his fist and then tries to pull his hand from the jar.

atoms.text:
“I’m stuck!” he exclaims. He pulls and pulls, but he can’t get his full hand back out.
“Ugh! Stupid jar!” he says, but he refuses to drop a single peanut.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m3_2025'>“I’m stuck!” </voice>he exclaims. He pulls and pulls, but he can’t get his full hand back out.<voice voice='m3_2025'> “Uh! Stupid jar!” </voice>he says, but he refuses to drop a single peanut.

atoms.text: His mother, watching Dalip struggle, says, “If you let go of some peanuts your fist would be smaller and you could pull it from the jar. Even if you don’t get as many peanuts now, they will still be there tomorrow and then you can enjoy them twice.”
atoms.sound: ssml: His mother, watching Dahleep struggle, says,<voice voice='f1'> “If you let go of some peanuts your fist would be smaller and you could pull it from the jar. Even if you don’t get as many peanuts now, they will still be there tomorrow and then you can enjoy them twice.”</voice>

atoms.text: Dalip lets go of just enough peanuts that his hand is again small enough to fit through the jar. He will have some more tomorrow.
atoms.sound: ssml: Dahleep lets go of just enough peanuts that his hand is again small enough to fit through the jar. He will have some more tomorrow.

atoms.a: Why did Dalip’s mother only allow him one handful of his favourite dish?
atoms.sound: Why did Dahleep’s mother only allow him one handful of his favourite dish?
b: ++to prevent him from spoiling his dinner

atoms.a: Why do you think he was unwilling to let go of the peanuts?
What is the lesson of this folktale?
b: ++Do not take too much at once.
